title: Dynamite Deka
overview:
That detective is always followed by a sense of danger and the smell of gunpowder.

Terrorists led by Wolf Hongo have seized Eternal City, a San Francisco skyscraper, and are holding the President's daughter Caroline hostage. Detectives Bruno Delinger and Cindy Holiday storm the building to rescue her.

Shoot, punch, kick and arrest your way through a 3D beat-'em-up with fighting-game style combos and throws. Grab anything at hand as a weapon - brooms, pepper shakers, chairs, pistols, machine guns and rocket launchers. Between fights, movie-like sequences with dynamic camera work call for split-second button presses, and failing one can cost health or force an extra battle.

- 1-2 players; team up to take down the terrorists, with combined special moves
- Includes the classic Sega arcade game Deep Scan

その刑事には危険の予感と火薬の香りがつきまとう。
